name: Wiphala (Qulla Suyu)

colors.symbolism: the earth and the Andean people

description: A square flag of forty-nine small squares in seven rows, the seven rainbow colours running in parallel diagonals.
history: The wiphala is the emblem of the Andean indigenous peoples; this version, with the white diagonal, represents Qulla Suyu, the southern quarter of the Inca realm covering the Aymara highlands. Standardized in the 20th-century indigenous movement, it became a co-official national symbol of Bolivia under the 2009 constitution.

features.role: 7×7 grid of squares with the seven colours running diagonally, white on the main diagonal
